## Summary
Summarize testing and MVP evaluation, including API latency, OCR quality, sync success, crash rate, and risk precision/recall where labeled data exists.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Metrics and methods are reproducible
- [ ] dataset limitations are described
- [ ] results and known gaps are documented.

## Scope notes
This issue is part of the ScamShield MVP backlog. Keep analysis deterministic and explainable, preserve privacy, and avoid definitive claims that a message is certainly a scam.
